To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the directed flow of protons in heavy-ion collisions at RHIC and LHC energies can be explained by considering the competing effects between the directed flow of transported and produced (or non-transported) protons.
the directed flow of inclusive and non-transportable protons is negative, while the directed flow of transported protons is positive.

(a) the sign-change of proton directed flow is due to the competing effect between transported and nontransported protons; (b) the directed flow difference between protons and anti-protons is due to non-transported anti-protons.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the directed flow of protons in the UrQMD model and the comparison with experimental results.
the study of directed flow of protons and antiprotions in the UrQMD model for Au+Au collision at various energies and centralities.
a systematic study of directed flow of protons and antiparticles at different beam energies in the framework of UrQMD model, with a special emphasis on understanding the sign-change of proton v1.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the sign-change of proton directed flow in the UrQMD model is caused by a competition between transported and nontransported protons, and not by the antiflow of protons.
the directed flow sign-change is not caused by a phase transition.

the UrQMD model explains most of the experimental data on directed flow of protons and antiparticles, and the observed sign-change of v1 is due to the competition between the directed flow of protracted and non-protracted protons.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the directed flow of protons and antiprotons in heavy-ion collisions at RHIC and SPS energies can be understood by a combination of the effects from transport and production.
the UrQMD model can qualitatively reproduce the experimental observations of directed flow for protons and antinuclei.
the UrQMD model can qualitatively reproduce the experimental data of v1 for protons, antiprotons and other hadrons.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the sign-change of v1 is not an indication of a QCD phase transition, and that the antiflow is a result of the interplay between the directed flow of the produced and the transported protons, and is not a new phenomenon in the QCD phase diagram.
the sign-change of the directed flow of protons is not an indication of the onset of a phase transition.
, the directed flow of protons in heavy-ion collisions is sensitive to the transport properties of the colliding nuclei, which is not captured by hydrodynamical models.
